files.content:
# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art styled Pomodoro timer built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests, fully offline.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Start/Pause and Reset buttons
- Large countdown display in MM:SS format
- Keyboard shortcuts: Space to start/pause, R to reset
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Accessible controls with visible focus states

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme and layout
- `script.js` — timer logic and interaction

## Constraints

- Offline only, no external assets or imports
- System fonts, 16px minimum
- Cohesive 3–5 color palette
